adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path changed from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` with a non-fatal `if (!tokenResponse.success) console.error(...)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) explicitly `throw`s when the safeParse fails (`throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`) regardless of whether sync is enabled (it only changes which schema is used, not whether it throws). This removes the prior diagnostic `console.error(..., "MS response:", responseJson)` and turns previously non-fatal schema mismatch into a hard failure for normal (non-sync) Outlook token refresh flows.
